latest_release.name: DeckCraft v0.16.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Animations: index morph matching and timeline lookups by shape by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1700
* Fonts: shape long items in bounded pieces by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1702
* ui: label animation effect options by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1579
* Preserve bullet sizes authored in points by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1588
* Transitions: play transition preview from previous slide when Preview is clicked (#1654) by @Naseq in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1679
* Reject unsupported handout perPage values in file.export by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1680
* Reject invalid master and layout indices in view.slideMaster by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1682
* Use a short temp file name in write_file for long file names by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1686
* Render: tiled picture fills keep their size in scaled groups and upright tiles by @leobasilio in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1693
* Comments: the pane keeps its width and resizes again (fixes #1431) by @Luis-0508 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1694
* Reject png/jpeg targets in file.save instead of writing zip bytes by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1698
* Format: bound native load work for the manifest, failed media reads and layout checks by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1704
* Pictures: compress grouped images at displayed size by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1707
* Preserve centered anchoring on table cells by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1709
* Preserve text overflow settings in PPTX by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1710
* Preserve compatible line spacing in PPTX by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1711
* Preserve normalized character height in PPTX by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1712
* Preserve Thai distributed paragraph alignment by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1713
* Remove deleted slides from custom shows by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1717
* Reuse custom table styles with reused slides by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1719
* Fit reused slides to the destination size by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1720
* Preserve RTL table direction on save by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1721
* Preserve alternate run language by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1722
* Preserve reflection transforms through save and reopen by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1723
* fix(pptx): place effects by their parent time node delays (fixes #1744) by @Naseq in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1751
* Remove dangling animations when merging shapes by @Harrison-Booth in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1716
* AV1, HEVC: count repeated-frame outputs incrementally and drop inherited entry-point storage by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1763
* Charts: group box values and stacked sums in one pass, share hierarchy labels, cap number formats by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1760
* PPTX: index media, layouts, sections and table styles on export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1761
* Review: replace each whole word in one pass by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1793
* Engine: check the temporary file's path against the write root by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/1792
* PPTX export: i

detail.readme_excerpt:
DeckCraft

Presentations and slide shows; an open-source, modern presentation and slide designer, built in pure Rust.

Build decks with themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, transitions and animations, open and save .pptx presentation files, and present them full screen. Native on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser. Every button is also a command that the CLI and AI agents (through MCP) can drive.


DeckCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**
detail.readme:
DeckCraft

Presentations and slide shows; an open-source, modern presentation and slide designer, built in pure Rust.

Build decks with themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, transitions and animations, open and save .pptx presentation files, and present them full screen. Native on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser. Every button is also a command that the CLI and AI agents (through MCP) can drive.


DeckCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps

> [!NOTE] > **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers, > filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil > last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

What works · Getting started · Agents, CLI and MCP · Roadmap · Downloads · The Crafting Apps · License

## What works today DeckCraft is in alpha, heading for beta (see the [roadmap](ROADMAP.md)). Today it can: - **Make decks**: slide masters and eleven layouts with placeholders that inherit position and formatting, eight original themes with colour and font schemes, sections, notes, comments, headers and footers, custom slide sizes. - **Draw**: 150+ preset shapes with adjust handles, connectors that stay glued to shapes, freeform, curve and scribble tools, merge shapes (union, combine, fragment, intersect, subtract), gradient, picture and pattern fills, outlines with dashes and arrowheads, shadows, glow, soft edges and reflections. - **Write**: in-place text editing with full font and paragraph formatting, bullets and numbering, columns, autofit, vertical text, fields and hyperlinks. - **Add content**: pictures with crop and corrections, tables with styles, charts, SmartArt basics, audio and video (MP3, AAC, FLAC, ALAC, Ogg, Opus, WAV, AIFF; H.264, HEVC, VP9, AV1). - **Present**: transitions (including Morph), entrance/emphasis/exit and motion-path animations, by-paragraph builds, full-screen slide show, presenter view, pen, rehearse timings, media playback. - **Exchange files**: open and save .pptx presentations, export PDF (slides, notes pages, handouts with selectable text), PNG/JPEG, an animated GIF of the deck and outlines. Unsaved work is kept by AutoRecover. - **Automate**: 200+ commands with undo, all scriptable from the CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server for AI agents.

Shape Format contextual tab and selection handles
Format Shape pane: gradient type, direction and stops

Slide Sorter with each slide's transition
Dark mode, with a native chart


The built-in sample deck, rendered by deckcraft-cli render --sample --all

## Getting started PDF export uses the shared `craft-pdf` writer with import features disabled. See [`crates/pdf/README.md`](crates/pdf/README.md) for the dependency and validation requirements. ```sh git clone https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft cd deckcraft cargo run --release -p deckcraft-cli -- render --sample --all --scale 1 out/ ``` On Linux, the build also needs the ALSA headers for slide-show sound: `alsa-lib-devel` on Fedora, `libasound2-dev` on Debian and Ubuntu, `alsa-lib` on Arch. Without them it stops at `alsa-sys`. Fonts come from [craft-fonts](https://github.com/storytold/craft-fonts): clone it next to this repo (`../craft-fonts`) and local builds pick it up automatically; without it DeckCraft uses your system fonts. Each [GitHub release](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/releases) has ready-made builds, on Linux as an AppImage, a `.deb`, an `.rpm` and a tarball. On Gentoo, the community [::snakebyte overlay](https://github.com/switch87/snakebyte-overlay) packages the Linux release as `app-office/deckcraft-bin` (not maintained by the DeckCraft team): ```sh eselect repository add snakebyte git https://github.com/switch87/snakebyte-overlay.git emaint sync -r snakebyte echo 'app-office/deckcraft-bin ~amd64' >> /etc/portage/package.accept_keywords/deckcraft emerge --ask app-office/deckcraft-bin ``` ### Logs The desktop app writes its `log` records to standard error and to `logs/deckcraft.log` in the settings directory, beside `ui.json` and `prefs.json` (Linux `~/.config/deckcraft/logs/`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/deckcraft/logs/`; macOS `~/Library/Application Support/DeckCraft/logs/`; Windows `%APPDATA%\DeckCraft\logs\`). A start from a desktop menu or the Dock has no terminal, so this file is what to attach to a bug report: the crash guard's panic report, a failed crash-recovery save, Parts skipped on import and audio output problems land there. Each launch moves the previous log to `deckcraft.1.log` (and that one to `deckcraft.2.log`), so the log of a run that crashed survives the next start. The file stops growing at 16 MiB. `--version` writes no file. | Variable | Effect | |---|---| | `RUST_LOG` | Log levels for standard error and the log file. Default: `info` for DeckCraft's own crates, `warn` for everything else. env_logger-style directives replace that, e.g. `RUST_LOG=debug`, `RUST_LOG=warn,deckcraft_pptx=trace` or `RUST_LOG=info,wgpu_core=warn`; a directive ending in `*` covers every target starting with it (`deckcraft*=debug`). | The logger is `apps/deckcraft/src/logging.rs`; the realtime audio callback does not log. The web app logs to the browser console instead. ## Agents, CLI and MCP Every action in DeckCraft is a command with a stable id, so people, scripts and AI agents use the same verbs: ```sh deckcraft-cli commands format. # list commands deckcraft-cli run --sample --cmd 'slide.new={"layout":"titleOnly","title":"Hello"}' --save hello.deckcraft deckcraft-cli mcp # MCP server over stdio (headless) deckcraft-cli mcp --connect 7990 # drive the running app (deckcraft --control 7990) deckcraft-cli mcp --automation-read-root DIR --automation-write-root DIR # confine the headless agent to folders ``` ## Roadmap DeckCraft is in **alpha**. It covers **84% of the features tracked in [`docs/target-app-parity.md`](docs/target-app-parity.md) by breadth** (92% of the core ones, measured) and is about **55% ready for real work across all tracked capabilities** (estimated). See [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) for the stage, numbers by dimension and what's next, [docs/target-app-parity.md](docs/target-app-parity.md) for the full assessment, [docs/gaps.md](docs/gaps.md) for every known shortfall and [docs/parity-checklist.md](docs/parity-checklist.md) for the feature-by-feature checklist. ## Downloads **Download DeckCraft** from GitHub: the [latest release](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/releases/latest) has every build listed below, and [all releases](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/releases) has earlier versions and their notes. `` in the file names is the version number, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file. ### Windows | Build | Installer | Portable | |---|---|---| | x64 (64-bit Intel/AMD) | `deckcraft--windows-x64.msi` | `deckcraft--windows-x64-portable.zip` | | arm64 (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs) | `deckcraft--windows-arm64.msi` | `deckcraft--windows-arm64-portable.zip` | | x86 (32-bit) | `deckcraft--windows-x86.msi` | `deckcraft--windows-x86-portable.zip` | Installers and executables are code-signed. **If the app doesn't open on Windows:** the desktop app initializes only DirectX 12 by default. Letting wgpu also create an OpenGL instance can crash some graphics drivers (AMD's `atio6axx.dll`) before the window appears, so the app would flash in Task Manager and quit. `WGPU_BACKEND` overrides the default for troubleshooting (for example `dx12` or `vulkan`). In PowerShell, from the folder containing the executable: ```powershell $env:WGPU_BACKEND = "vulkan" & .\deckcraft.exe Remove-Item Env:WGPU_BACKEND # restore the default for later launches ``` An explicit `gl` override can bring the driver crash back on affected systems. The macOS, Linux and web backend defaults are unchanged. DirectX 12 shaders are compiled with FXC, which is part of Windows, so no `dxcompiler.dll` or `dxil.dll` is needed ("Parent device is lost" at start, #153). `$env:WGPU_DX12_COMPILER = "dxc"` (or `"auto"`) selects wgpu's DXC handling again for troubleshooting. ### macOS | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | App, universal (Apple silicon + Intel) | `deckcraft--macos-universal.dmg` | Signed and notarized | | Command-line tool, universal | `deckcraft-cli--macos-universal.zip` | Signed and notarized | ### Linux | Format | x86_64 | aarch64 (ARM64) | Notes | |---|---|---|---| | AppImage | `deckcraft--linux-x86_64.AppImage` | `deckcraft--linux-aarch64.AppImage` | Runs anywhere; updates itself with [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/AppImageUpdate) (`.zsync` files) | | Flatpak | `deckcraft--linux-x86_64.flatpak` | `deckcraft--linux-aarch64.flatpak` | Sandboxed; `flatpak install --user ` | | Debian/Ubuntu | `deckcraft--linux-x86_64.deb` | `deckcraft--linux-aarch64.deb` | | | Fedora/RHEL/openSUSE | `deckcraft--linux-x86_64.rpm` | `deckcraft--linux-aarch64.rpm` | | | Tarball | `deckcraft--linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `deckcraft--linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Unpack anywhere | RISC-V 64 (riscv64): `deckcraft--linux-riscv64.tar.gz`, a tarball only (cross-compiled; needs glibc 2.39+, e.g. Ubuntu 24.04+). **Runtime libraries.** The window-system, GPU and file-dialog libraries DeckCraft needs are opened when the app starts (`dlopen` through `x11-dl`, `xkbcommon-dl`, `ash`, `glutin` and `rfd`) instead of being linked in, so `ldd` shows none of them: an install that satisfies the linked dependencies can still fail at start-up with a loader error and no hint of what to install. Only `libasound.so.2` (slide-show sound) is a hard link-time dependency, and only of the `deckcraft` GUI — `deckcraft-cli` uses neither sound nor a display. The `.deb` and `.rpm` declare the set in `packaging/linux/nfpm.yaml`; a tarball install or a musl system has to provide it itself: ```sh apk add libx11 libxcursor libxrandr libxi libxkbcommon xkeyboard-config \ wayland-libs-client alsa-lib \ vulkan-loader mesa-vulkan-swrast \ mesa-gl mesa-egl mesa-dri-gallium \ xdg-desktop-portal ``` Alpine Linux `v3.22` names above; Void's musl variant uses the same `/lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1` loader and the same libraries as `libX11 libXcursor libXrandr libXi libxkbcommon xkeyboard-config wayland alsa-lib vulkan-loader mesa xdg-desktop-portal`. There is no musl build among the release artifacts yet — this is what a build from source on musl needs at run time, and what a future musl artifact will need (#954). - `mesa-vulkan-swrast` is the software Vulkan driver: it runs anywhere, VMs and containers included. On a real GPU install your vendor's driver instead (`mesa-vulkan-intel`, `mesa-vulkan-ati`, `mesa-vulkan-nouveau`, …). - Without Vulkan the app falls back to CPU rendering through Mesa's GL drivers. It works, but slowly — a driver limit, not a DeckCraft bug. - `xdg-desktop-portal` (with `xdg-desktop-portal-gtk` or `-kde`; `-wlr` has no file chooser, so on wlroots compositors install `zenity`) is what the Open and Save dialogs talk to; `xkeyboard-config` holds the XKB keyboard data `libxkbcommon` reads. - fontconfig and freetype are not needed: DeckCraft reads `/usr/share/fonts` itself and embeds its presentation fonts. Building from source on musl also needs `build-base pkgconf alsa-lib-dev` (`alsa-lib-dev` is the ALSA headers). ### FreeBSD | Build | File | |---|---| | x86_64 | `deckcraft--freebsd-x86_64.tar.gz` | ### Web (WebAssembly) | Build | File | Notes | |---|---|---| | Static site | `deckcraft-web-.zip` | Runs in a modern browser; host it on any static server | ## The Crafting Apps DeckCraft is one of
